patterns.name: Access management
patterns.purpose: Manage workspace invitations, roles, selection, permissions, mutation progress, and failure recovery.
decisionRules: Use the coded composition when access roles and member-management anatomy match the contract.
Create a separate product composition when domain anatomy or workflow differs substantially.

patterns.name: Filter, query, and result states
patterns.purpose: Combine query input, bounded filters, result state, stale-data messaging, retry, and permission-aware actions.
decisionRules: Use local filtering for small in-memory collections.
Distinguish empty data from criteria-driven no-results.
Keep this as a recipe because products vary in query syntax, URL state, result layout, and mobile anatomy.
